title: Nepal-Tibet death toll rises amid new flood fears and race to free group trapped in tunnel
summary_full: Combined toll of more than 750 dead and 3,000 people missing in Nepal and Tibet after devastating floodNepal-Tibet flash flood – latest updates‘Their whole village has disappeared’: frantic hunt for survivors in Kathmandu hospitalRescuers in Nepal and Tibet have battled through leg-sucking mud amid the threat of fresh flooding to search for thousands of people still missing after a deadly wall of water swept through the Himalayan border zone, engulfing entire villages.The latest updates on Sunday put the number of missing at 3,048, including hundreds of foreigners. There were 768 confirmed deaths, and reports of some bodies swept downstream possibly as far as India. Continue reading...
